rule: at the end of the day
Maximum characters for the LinkedIn post
Maximum characters for the Instagram caption
Maximum characters for the WhatsApp broadcast
Maximum characters for one hook line
Write like one person talking to another person. Short sentences. No stacked adjectives.
One idea per line. Break long text into paragraphs of one to three lines.
Lead with something specific. A number, a named thing or a real moment in the first two lines.
Indian English. Use Rs for money and lakh or crore for large numbers.
Open with a statement, never with a question.
End on one clear line. Never beg for comments, shares or follows.
Never claim a result, a number or a client name that was not given to you.
No motivational framing. Say what happened and what it means.
First two lines must work alone, because that is all LinkedIn shows before the more link.
Caption is written for someone who already saw the image. Do not describe the image.
Written for a broadcast list. Direct, useful, no greeting, no sign off.
